m2-griptriplet.title: Fracture 2: GRIP-TRIPLET — partial correlation controlling for circuit
m2-griptriplet.imperative: Add fracture_2_grip_triplet(db_path) to the script: load EstimateStore(db_path).load(year=2023, session_type='Q', status='ok') GUARDED (skip gracefully with a message if db_path does not exist), drop rows with NaN in lateral_mech_grip_g/brake_decel_ms2/traction_accel_ms2, compute RAW pairwise Pearson correlations, then circuit-controlled (residualize by demeaning each variable within its gp_name group) partial correlations for the 3 pairs, and derive a bound: max tightening of pooled grip sigma a joint solve could achieve = (1 - sqrt(1 - r_max^2)) * 100% using the max |circuit-controlled r|. Print both raw and controlled correlations and the bound number. Guard: if DB absent, bounded-defer with an explicit reason (no crash).
